wrap_order: each of 32 model.layers decoder blocks bottom-up
rotation_bank: unsharded, per-rank replicated, trainable theta=0 Hadamard initialization
recurrent_states: not parameters or buffers; never sharded or split
input_distribution: same frozen non-AIME token IDs on both ranks for diagnostic parity
embedding_and_lm_head: distinct storage in frozen Qwen checkpoint; shard independently
final_norm: shard as a separate FSDP unit
